description: Perform tank repairs on a field fabricated aboveground storage tanks FAC 10515 FAC 105161 at Pease ANGB Portsmouth, NH based on approved Inspection report option(s) to include: Scope of Work, Drawings, and Cost Estimate. Conduct Stakeholder and internal reviews, as needed, to generate Advertisement package. Tank will be brought into conformance with API 653, NFPA 30, applicable UFGS and in compliance with 40 CFR 112, UFC 3-460-03, AW 78-24-27 and any other applicable federal, state or local requirements  Respond to all Bidder Inquiry questions during the proposal phase, and provide a Conformed Set (contract award package).
